preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 58.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n and 1 <= r_i <= n for b_i, r_i in arcs)
preconditions.description: Each blue and red arc must connect to valid vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v < n and len(s) == n - 1 and all(c in 'RB' for c in s) for v, s in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify a valid vertex and a string of length n-1 with only 'R' and 'B' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not reachable else str(t_i)
postconditions.description: Output -1 if the state is unreachable, otherwise output the first time the state appears.
The time t_i must be non-negative if the state is reachable.
